findings.title: Food obtained from approved source.
findings.comment: Observed that the establishment is hot holding manufactured cheese sauce in a dispenser (opened on day 1, and discarded on day 7), which is beyond the terms of their Category 3A - Low Risk permit, which does not allow for hot holding of any food items. CORRECTED: PIC and Owner were informed, and will cease serving hot held cheese sauce. Please contact SCDPH if establishment plans to change the menu to include food preparation like hot holding. Inspectors suggested acquiring single service shelf stable sauces that can be heated up by customers in the establishment’s microwave.
findings.citation_text: 3-201.11(A) Compliance with Food Law. (A) FOOD shall be obtained from sources that comply with LAW. [P]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed the bar hand washing sink did not have paper towels when the inspector arrived. The PIC was informed and they brought a roll of paper towels to the hand washing sink. They were reminded of the importance of hand drying for the proper hand washing procedure. Ensure that paper towels are always available at every handwashing sink.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.
